interpretation: The cumulative index PDFs are official EOIR topical indexes, not case opinions and not replacements for the missing bound volumes.
Together they provide first-party topical coverage through volume 27; the volumes 1-15 scans require OCR, while volumes 16-27 have native text.
They can validate historical reporter citations and rule-to-case relationships.

The formal affected-decisions notice is first-party reporter editorial evidence with explicit treatment codes through volume 25. It is the strongest available treatment seed, but it is historical rather than a current comprehensive citator and expressly points to volume 15 for earlier cumulative coverage.

The separate BIA Precedent Chart adds headnotes and some later-treatment annotations for a limited 1995-2017 window, but its publisher disclaimer makes it secondary recall evidence rather than a citator.
Entries repeat the same case under multiple topics, so all supporting output must be deduplicated by case identity before use.
